normalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 visible terminal-cell rows after ANSI-control removal and outer-whitespace trimming. Every accepted row pins exact raw projected and rendered hashes plus one-based inclusive blank-column ranges.
policy: Fail-closed review of production-status and provenance cues in every static color-script payload. Accept only exact separable originality or anti-rip claims and detached creation date, completion, line-count, release-time, or production-note spans proven by complete-panel and family context; retain titles, identity, attribution, copyright, authored dialogue or captions, functional interfaces, structural text, slogans, and ambiguity.
